purpose: Food-inspired BetterFlash logo concepts for user selection

concepts.label: B1 / Blueberry
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new BetterFlash food-inspired app logo concept.
Art direction: somewhat cartoonish, friendly and rounded, yet sleek, modern, educational and professional. A carefully drawn editorial food emblem with character in its curves and proportions. Use bold smooth contours, very few large internal details, flat color fills, restrained tonal planes. It must remain recognizable when reduced to a 24-32 pixel application icon. Natural food colors, polished optical balance, no over-detailed illustration.
Presentation: one square 1024x1024 specimen. Solid flat aubergine background #211722. One large standalone food mark, approximately 350-410 pixels across, centered at x512 y430. Beneath it at y720, the exact wordmark "BetterFlash" in warm ivory #f7eee8, medium-weight IBM Plex Mono-like monospace type, approximately 46px. Upper left at x65 y65 place the exact small ivory monospaced caption specified below. Generous negative space. Use a restrained ivory contour or negative-space keyline if needed to separate a dark food from the background.
Make the symbol a distinctive brand design, not a stock emoji, stock food clip art, or a children's sticker. No faces, eyes, mouths, arms, legs, emojis, hats, sharp triangular silhouettes, crowns with pointed tips, brains, lightbulbs, sparkles, graduation caps, book/card props or unrelated objects. No gradients, glows, drop shadows, texturing, realism, 3D mockups, extra labels, badge circles, enclosing frames or watermarks. Avoid fussy highlights and tiny details. No food or nutrition claims. Render the two specified text strings exactly.
Caption (verbatim): "B1 / Blueberry".
Specific design: A single plump, slightly squat blueberry with a charming asymmetrical round silhouette. Main fill is a rich muted blueberry indigo, one broad periwinkle crescent-shaped tonal plane on the upper left. On its upper-right face, a small botanical blueberry calyx rendered as a soft five-lobed rounded indentation, with no sharp star points. A clean ivory outer contour allows recognition on the dark background. No stem, leaf, or small shine dots. This is a polished, memorable berry emblem.
